rows.text: They're always the one organizing group hangouts, thrives at parties, and talks to strangers easily. Being alone for too long leaves them restless.
They love being the center of attention at any gathering and get their energy from being surrounded by people. Quiet nights alone bore them fast.
They need a lot of alone time to recharge and find big parties exhausting. They'd rather have one deep conversation than work a whole room.
Loud group settings overwhelm them, and they usually leave social events early to go home and decompress by themselves.
They love debating abstract theories and hypothetical futures, and get bored fast by step-by-step instructions. Always thinking about the big picture and hidden patterns.
They're constantly speculating about what things could become, drawn to symbolism and possibility over anything concrete or literal.
They're extremely detail-oriented and practical, and trust what they can directly observe over abstract theory. They want the specifics, not the big idea.
They focus on facts and what's directly in front of them, and get impatient with vague hypotheticals that aren't grounded in something real.
They make decisions based on pure logic and facts, can come across as blunt, and value being correct over being liked.
They approach conflict by picking apart the argument for logical flaws, not by considering how anyone might feel about it.
They make decisions based on how it will affect people's feelings, are deeply empathetic, and prioritize harmony over being technically right.
They can't stand seeing someone upset and will bend their own opinion to keep the peace and make sure everyone feels okay.
They love making lists and sticking to plans, get anxious when things are last-minute or disorganized, and crave closure and structure.
They plan every trip down to the hour and get visibly stressed when a schedule falls apart.
They're spontaneous and flexible, hate rigid schedules, and would rather keep their options open than commit to a fixed plan.
They decide what to do that day when they wake up, and find detailed itineraries suffocating.
